name: Morpho Vault: Grove x Steakhouse High Yield AUSD

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bounded bypass

narrative.summary: The largest Morpho vault on Monad (~$108K TVL, a very early deployment). curator() and guardian() resolve to the identical 2-of-6 Safe - no independent veto party during the vault’s own 14-day cap-change timelock.
narrative.detail: A real 14-day timelock exists on per-market cap changes, but because the proposing party (curator) and the vetoing party (guardian) are the same multisig, the delay’s independent-check purpose doesn’t hold in practice. The separate 5-of-8 owner Safe governs meta-parameters (curator appointment, fees).

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
